SHA-256, watch-only and Lightning update:

- Imported BTC Native SegWit public accounts can use hardware signing. Enable Use with hardware wallet (BTC SHA-256) in wallet details, review the transaction, scan it with your signing device, then scan the signed QR back. RedWallet verifies the signatures, recipient/change and fee before offering Send. Verify those details on the device too. Your recovery phrase stays on the device. Physical Keystone compatibility remains part of this beta's device testing.
- Sparrow-compatible and Keystone public-account QR imports work without entering a recovery phrase. Native SegWit BIP84 accounts are supported; other hardware account types remain unavailable.
- Watch-only cards stay gray with a red XBT corner coin or blue SHA-256 corner coin. Hot-wallet card colors are unchanged.
- BTC SHA-256 has its own editable server settings and chain connection, separate from XBT. New XBT installations use Kilombino's certificate-verified SSL Fulcrum preset.
- Add/remove channel funds now waits for iOS to return to the foreground after successful Face ID. Canceling authentication or leaving the app cancels the authorization without retrying. A finished resize is labeled completed, instead of locked.
- Channel resize status shows the transaction's measured confirmations and each side's lock status. The peer's confirmation requirement is marked unavailable when the node does not report it. Funds become available after the resize locks; foreground refresh updates the balance without submitting another resize.
- Balance details separate available funds, pending funding/channels/resize, locked outputs and reserves. Lightning availability is an estimate; routing, limits and fees can reduce the amount you can pay. Hidden amounts stay masked.
- Lightning payments show confirmed success or failure and retain unknown/pending results for status checks. No automatic payment retry. Outgoing payments are red and incoming payments green.
- Total-balance display cycles units and hidden amounts and can be revealed again. Transaction history scrolls below the fixed dashboard; the green LED marks verified chain status. Settings headings and saved Dark Angel/Templar skins are retained.
- New Lightning channels retain the 10,000,000-sat opening cap. Existing channel resizing keeps its separate amount and fee rules.

Update the existing app in TestFlight; no reimport is required. SHA-256 server connections use the direct network. Tor covers the embedded Lightning paths and configured watchtowers; quote requests use direct HTTPS.
